findings.evidence: One.lean:86,114 give the `c = 1` case at the raw-function and function-space levels; Action.lean:260-264 and 354-358 derive the bundled versions from it via the `coe_` lemmas (ModularForm.lean:186,192). The PR's two proofs differ only in `ModularForm.ext` vs `CuspForm.ext` and the `_eq_sum` lemma name.
findings.fix: Prove `twistedHeckeSlashSum k χ (diagCosetGamma0 N ![c,c] _) f = ((χ c : ℂ) * c ^ (k-2)) • f` for `f ∈ functionCharSpace k χ`, package it as `twistedHeckeSlashSumCharEnd ... = (...) • 1` (and `heckeRingHomFunctionCharSpace_heckeTScalarGamma0`), then obtain the modular and cusp statements through `coe_twistedHeckeSlashModularFormCharEnd` / `coe_twistedHeckeSlashCuspFormCharEnd`, exactly as `twistedHeckeSlashModularFormCharLinearMap_one` (Action.lean:260) and its cusp twin (Action.lean:354) do for `c = 1`.
findings.issue: The scalar action is proved only at the two bundled levels, duplicating the same coset-sum computation (lines 183-187 and 200-204), and is missing at the `functionCharSpace` level — where the `c = 1` special case of this very statement already lives (`twistedHeckeSlashSum_one`, One.lean:86; `twistedHeckeSlashSumCharEnd_one`, One.lean:114) and from which Action.lean derives both bundled forms.

summary: The scalar action is proved twice at the bundled modular/cusp level and never at the function-space level where the c = 1 case already lives and from which Action.lean derives both bundled forms; three supporting lemmas are also stated below their natural level (scalar matrix, general diagonal tuple, general subgroup normalizer), re-deriving facts Mathlib and this repo already have in general form.
